newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two die, 10 injured in Russian helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Two die, 10 injured in Russian helicopter crash.

text.p: Two people died and another 10 were injured when a helicopter evacuating wounded soldiers from Chechnya crashed outside the rebel region on Sunday, Itar-Tass news agency said.
The MI-8 burst into flames while landing at Vladikavkaz, capital of the ethnic region of North Ossetia in southern Russia.

It was flying from the key Russian base of Khankala just outside the Chechen capital Grozny. Fighting stopped in Chechnya last month when the Russian authorities struck a ceasefire deal with separatist rebels.
Military officials told Tass they had no idea what had caused the crash.
